label: GO
recommendation: Run a 90-day paid site-intelligence service for Kigali-based real-estate developers. Use manual delivery to validate the buyer and repeatable workflow, then productise only what buyers repeatedly pay for.
conditions: At least five paid assessments within 90 days.
At least two repeat orders, retainer requests or referrals.
By the fifth report, direct delivery costs targeted below 50% of collected fees.
All material claims show source, date and confidence; no legal title or valuation guarantees.
No hires, debt or speculative development commitments during the test.
next_steps: By 2026-11-28: define the Site Decision Brief, data-source register, exclusions and payment terms.
By 2026-12-21: complete 20 buyer conversations and secure the first paid pilots.
By 2027-02-19: review five paid reports, repeat demand, contribution margin and productisation decision.
cheapest_test: Offer ten Kigali developers a paid assessment for a live parcel decision and collect a deposit before research.
kill_criteria: Stop or reshape if fewer than three of 20 qualified buyers pay, if the report does not change decisions, if delivery cost remains above 70% of fees after five reports, or if reliable lawful data cannot be secured.
